pass.description: Pass under review, e.g. blockout, structural, materials, surface, lighting-camera, interaction-ui, optimization, anim-rig, optimization-export, final

layer_scores.description: Five fixed rubric layers, every review (adapted from Object Sculptor)

features.description: One entry per spec critical_features[] item — all of them, every gate

important_features.description: One entry per spec important_features[] item, when the spec defines any — same shape as features[]

important_average.description: Average score of important_features[], when present; PASS formula requires >= 0.65

assumed_thresholds.description: Retrofit gate only: record assumed thresholds here instead of a root global_min key

defects.description: What is wrong, in pixel terms

corrections.description: Imperative, actionable fixes for the modeler

color_delta_e00.description: Objective material-read anchor: CIEDE2000 (dE00) distance of the render crop's mean sRGB to the spec-declared colorTarget, measured by material-color-probe.mjs. Required on a materials/surface PASS when the spec declares colorTarget.deltaE00Max; gate-state.mjs enforces dE00 <= that max. null/absent when the spec declares no colorTarget.

tests.description: Invariant suite result when the design has one; null (with a note) when it has none — never fabricate

verdict.description: PASS iff mechanical green (incl. tests null-or-fail==0) AND global_score >= global_min AND every critical feature >= threshold AND (if spec has important_features) important_average >= 0.65 — the full formula lives in GATES.md §Verdict

action.description: continue=advance pass; refine-spec=fix YAML first, never patch code around a bad spec; refine-code=apply corrections; request-input=need better reference; stop=fidelity unreachable from current inputs
